intro: Vespera sofa offers tailored comfort in a compact form. It's designed with soft curves, a solid frame and a calming dual-tone leatherette that fits beautifully into any space.

features.title: Style that makes a statement
features.text: With its bold dual-tone design, our sofa brings depth, contrast, and character to your living space. It pairs beautifully with both modern and traditional interiors—effortlessly standing out without overwhelming the room.

features.title: Feels like luxury, lives like leather
features.text: Wrapped in premium synthetic leather, our sofa offers the refined look and feel of genuine leather—yet stays breathable, comfortable, and refreshingly easy to maintain.

features.title: Armrests that do more
features.text: More than just a place to rest your arms—our wide, flat-top armrests double up as a casual spot for your coffee mug or snack bowl, making your downtime even more relaxed.

features.title: Cushions that care for you
features.text: The loose cushions are generously filled for a soft, enveloping feel. They mould gently to your shape and can be repositioned to suit your perfect sitting posture.

features.title: Surfaces that stay spotless with ease
features.text: The smooth, wipe-clean synthetic leather resists everyday spills and stains—helping you keep your sofa looking effortlessly fresh with minimal effort.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
